title: Player · Baby Come Back
description: The full supplied performance with original music, four physical singers and five band figures.

parts.name: Lead · blue shirt and dark vest

melody.name: Baby Come Back
melody.lyrics: Spending all my nights, all my money going out on the town Doing anything just to get you off my mind When the morning comes, I'm right back where I started again And trying to forget you is just a waste of time Baby come back Any kind of fool could see There was something in everything about you Baby come back, you can blame it all on me I was wrong and I just can't live without you All day long, wearing a mask of false bravado Trying to keep up a smile that hides a tear But as the sun goes down, I get that empty feeling again I wish to God that you were here Baby come back, oh baby Any kind of fool could see There was something in everything about you Baby come back You can blame it all on me I was wrong and I just can't live without you Now that I put it all together Give me the chance to make you see Have you used up all the love in your heart Nothing left for me Nothing left for me Baby come back, come back, come back Any kind of fool could see There was something in everything about you Baby come back, listen baby You can blame it all on me I was wrong and I just can't live without you I was wrong and I just can't live
